title: Release
description: companion → plugin. The harness may discard what it holds for one conversation: the agent's lane pass on a card ended (pass_ended), the card was archived (archived), or its conversation deleted (deleted). It withdraws no request — an open one is cancelled first — and a plugin that ignores it is still correct, only wasteful.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.
